title: M2a barrier-certificate transcript (v1.0)
description: Shape contract for the M2a de Bruijn-Newman barrier certificate: three document kinds -- 'manifest' (the barrier lane's rectangle, final time t0 and prism list), 'prism' (one time prism: the seam exclusion transcript in the W1 row vocabulary plus the floor, the approximation defect E and the displacement D), and 'asymptotic' (the final-time window rows and the Lemma-T tail row). Normative semantics, the checker clauses C-B0..C-B13 and C-A1..C-A6, and the displayed hypotheses live in SPEC.md (same directory). This schema enforces SHAPE only: a schema-valid file can still be checker-rejected. All integers are decimal strings (JSON native numbers are forbidden for checked data, as in w1-schema.json).

intStr.description: arbitrary-precision integer as a decimal string

rat.description: exact rational n/d, d > 0 syntactically; need not be reduced; compared by cross-multiplication

row.description: W1 row (FORMAT.md section 5-6, verbatim): value box reLo<=K*Re f<=reHi, imLo<=K*Im f<=imHi for ALL points of the closed segment, and the argument-increment enclosure argLo<=A*(Delta/2pi)<=argHi in TURN units -- here for the seam approximant f (SPEC.md section 4.2).

trustLabel.const: kernel-checked modulo the displayed hypotheses H1, H2 (H2-B, H2-A, H-TAIL) and H3 (producers untrusted)

rect.description: the common barrier rectangle R = [x1,x2] x [y1,y2] in the z = x+iy plane (checker C-B2': x1 < x2, 0 < y1 < y2; the instance glue checks x1 = X, x2 = X+1, y1 <= y0, y2 >= 1)

t0.description: final time t0 > 0; the last prism is [last seam, t0]

prisms.description: prism list in time order; checker C-B13: first seam = 0, seams strictly increasing, last seam < t0. Each entry names the prism file; the file's own 'seam' must equal the entry's.

producer.description: UNTRUSTED provenance metadata (both legs record implementation, version, precision, the f_t evaluator's identity, the E and D derivations' inputs)

seam.description: the seam time tau_j = left endpoint of the prism [tau_j, tau_{j+1}] (tau_J := t0)

scales.description: K: value scale of this prism's rows, floor, E and D; A: argument scale in turn units (producer requirement: A even, >= 2)

mesh.description: boundary mesh of R, FORMAT.md section 4 conventions verbatim: bottom (Re: x1->x2 increasing), right (Im: y1->y2 increasing), top (Re: x2->x1 DEcreasing), left (Im: y2->y1 DEcreasing); endpoints included; checker C-B3

segments.description: one row per boundary segment, global traversal order; count = sum over edges of (breakpoints-1) (C-B4); rows enclose the seam approximant f_{tau_j}

modulus_floor.description: the floor |f| >= Fn/Fd on all of dR at the seam (checker C-B11, FORMAT.md section 5.2 integer-squares scheme)

approx_defect.description: E: |g_{tau_j} - f| <= E/K on dR, g = H_t/B_t (Theorem 1.3 defect e_A+e_B+e_C0, uniform on dR at the seam; SPEC.md section 4.4)

displacement.description: D: |g_t - g_{tau_j}| <= D/K on dR for tau_j <= t <= tau_{j+1} (SPEC.md section 4.5); checker C-B12: (E + D)*Fd < Fn*K

producer.description: UNTRUSTED: per-prism diagnostics for the two-producer cross-check -- f boxes before E-inflation, the E bound's inputs, D_t and delta t, mesh policy, timings

yA.description: top of the y-range; checker C-A1: yA^2 >= 1 - 2*t0 (so [y0,yA] covers Theorem 1.2(ii)'s y0 <= y <= sqrt(1-2t0))

rows.description: window rows in increasing N, consecutive (C-A4: next Nlo = Nhi + 1); each certifies |g_{t0}(x+iy)| >= (T-E)/K for N(x) in [Nlo,Nhi], y in [y0,yA] (SPEC.md section 5.2); C-A3: 0 <= E < T

tail.description: the Lemma-T tail row (SPEC.md section 5.4): N1 = last Nhi + 1 (C-A5); Q1..Q4, E1 = integer upper bounds at scale K of the five finite quantities; C-A6: Q1+Q2+Q3+Q4+E1 < 2K

producer.description: UNTRUSTED: per-row diagnostics (the mollifier set, sigma lower bounds, the E derivation inputs) and the tail row's constants (sigma_1, epsilon, k_1, kappa_T, psi values)
